The '''Asian Scientist 100''' is an annually published list of 100 prize-winning Asian researchers, academicians, innovators and business leaders from across the Asia-Pacific region and a range of scientific disciplines, by the English language science and technology magazine ''[[Asian Scientist]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.a-star.edu.sg/ihpc/news/news/publicity-highlights/the-asian-scientist-100-list-2020 |title= THE ASIAN SCIENTIST 100 LIST 2020 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 12 October 2020 |website= |publisher=A*STAR Institute of High Performance Computing |access-date= 11 March 2025 |quote= |language= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://science.cmb.ac.lk/old/the-asian-scientist-100/index.htm |title= 
The Asian Scientist 100 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= Faculty of Science |publisher= [[University of Colombo]] |access-date= 11 March 2025 |quote= |language= }}</ref>

To be selected for this list, the recipient must have won a national or international research prize in the past year, or have demonstrated significant achievement through a major scientific discovery or leadership in academia or industry.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.asianscientist.com/as100/ |title=The Asian Scientist 100 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= |publisher= [[Asian Scientist]] |access-date= 11 March 2025 |quote= |language= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.science.nus.edu.sg/blog/2023/07/asian-scientist-100-2023/ |title= Asian Scientist 100 (2023) |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 10 July 2023 |website= College of Humanities and Sciences |publisher= [[National University of Singapore]] |access-date= 11 March 2025 |quote= |language= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.dlsu.edu.ph/asian-scientist-100/ |title=Asian Scientist 100 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 17 November 2022 |website= |publisher= [[De La Salle University]] |access-date= 11 March 2025 |quote= |language= }}</ref>

The Asian Scientist 100 is an annually published list of 100 prize-winning Asian researchers, academicians, innovators and business leaders from across the Asia-Pacific region and a range of scientific disciplines, by the English language science and technology magazine Asian Scientist.
To be selected for this list, the recipient must have won a national or international research prize in the past year, or have demonstrated significant achievement through a major scientific discovery or leadership in academia or industry.
